name: Panokseon
description: Banwukong (Korean: 판옥선) is a large warship used during the Imjin Japanese Rebellion in the Joseon Dynasty. The wooden house ship is huge, can carry nearly a hundred people, and has a slow sailing speed, but it can be operated flexibly by only dozens of sailors during combat. At that time, the Korean Navy often used wooden boats as the main warships, and used small fast boats such as sword ships and fierce ships as escorts to form a naval force.
